metadata.title: Magic-state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor

zh.headline: 在真实芯片上“培育”魔术态，错误降到约四十分之一
zh.summary: 魔术态是容错量子计算执行非 Clifford 门的关键资源；谷歌首次在 Willow 超导处理器上实现“魔术态培育”，把编码 T 态的错误降低约 40 倍。
zh.question: 制备高保真魔术态通常要耗费大量量子比特，能否用更省的办法？
zh.approach: 在小型色码中注入噪声态，反复做容错测量并后选择，再嫁接到表面码；同时设计容错测量方案来界定保真度。
zh.finding: 错误降低约 40 倍，保真度下界达 0.9999(1)，代价是只保留约 8% 的尝试。
zh.caution:
只演示了最小版本（距离 3）。
保留率约 8%，产出速率与规模化仍需验证。
limitations: 只演示了最小版本（距离 3）。
保留率约 8%，产出速率与规模化仍需验证。

terms.name: 魔术态
terms.description: 用来实现 T 门等非 Clifford 操作的特殊量子态，是通用容错计算的必需资源。

terms.name: 后选择
terms.description: 只保留检测中没有发现错误的运行结果。

en.headline: Cultivating cleaner magic states for quantum computing
en.summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computing needs high-quality magic states, but conventional distillation is resource intensive. This study demonstrates magic-state cultivation on a superconducting processor and develops a fidelity assessment procedure. Cultivation substantially reduces state errors, at the cost of rejecting most attempts.
en.question: Can a superconducting processor prepare high-quality magic states with fewer resources?
en.approach: Use fault-tolerant cultivation, post-selection and a self-referenced fidelity assessment.
steps: Prepare a noisy state in a distance-three color code
Measure fault-tolerantly and discard detected errors
Transfer the state into a distance-five surface code
Estimate fidelity with a self-referenced procedure

flow.title: Inject
flow.description: Prepare a noisy state in a distance-three color code

flow.title: Cultivate
flow.description: Measure fault-tolerantly and discard detected errors

flow.title: Graft
flow.description: Transfer the state into a distance-five surface code

flow.title: Assess
flow.description: Estimate fidelity with a self-referenced procedure

en.finding: Cultivation reduces state errors by about 40 times, while retaining about 8% of attempts.
en.caution: The demonstration uses a distance-three code; scaling and throughput remain open questions.
limitations: The demonstration uses a distance-three code; scaling and throughput remain open questions.

terms.name: Magic state
terms.description: A resource enabling non-Clifford operations such as T gates.

terms.name: Post-selection
terms.description: Retaining only attempts that pass specified checks.

abstractSummary.zh: 容错量子计算需要大量高质量的魔术态，传统蒸馏方法占用的资源极多。谷歌团队首次在超导芯片上完整演示了更省资源的“魔术态培育”，并配套设计了可信的保真度评估方法；培育后的态错误显著下降，代价是要舍弃大部分尝试。
abstractSummary.en: Fault-tolerant quantum computing needs high-quality magic states, but conventional distillation is resource intensive. This study demonstrates magic-state cultivation on a superconducting processor and develops a fidelity assessment procedure. Cultivation substantially reduces state errors, at the cost of rejecting most attempts.

zh.headline: 给望远镜做“数字孪生”，从旧数据里找回被星光淹没的行星
zh.summary: FLIP 用物理模型精确模拟星光如何穿过望远镜，再用机器学习优化把星光扣除，在 JWST 存档数据中重新找到了此前未检出的系外行星。
zh.question: 望远镜的微小不稳定让星光扣不干净，能否突破这一限制，拍到更暗的行星？
zh.approach: 为 JWST 构建物理“数字孪生”，用数值优化求解残余星光并扣除，而不是依赖不完美的参考图像。
zh.finding: 存档数据中的灵敏度提升 2–15 倍，并以超过 5σ 的显著性检出此前分析中未见的 51 Eridani b。
zh.caution:
尚未达到光子噪声极限。
还没有在地基望远镜上验证。
计算成本较高。
limitations: 尚未达到光子噪声极限。

en.headline: A telescope digital twin reveals planets hidden in archival data
en.summary: Starlight overwhelms the faint signal from an exoplanet, and telescope instability limits conventional reference-image subtraction. The authors build a physical model of JWST to reconstruct and remove starlight. Reprocessing archival observations improves sensitivity by a reported factor of 2–15 and reveals the previously undetected planet 51 Eridani b.
en.question: Can physical modeling overcome the stability limit of direct exoplanet imaging?
en.approach: Reconstruct starlight with a physical JWST model and optimize it with machine learning.
steps: Fit the physical model to observations
Remove modeled starlight to reveal residual planetary signals

flow.title: Optimize
flow.description: Fit the physical model to observations

flow.title: Subtract
flow.description: Remove modeled starlight to reveal residual planetary signals

en.finding: Archival-data sensitivity improves by 2–15 times; 51 Eridani b is detected above five sigma.
en.caution: The method does not remove photon noise; ground-based validation and computational cost remain limitations.
limitations: The method does not remove photon noise; ground-based validation and computational cost remain limitations.

terms.name: Direct imaging
terms.description: Separating faint planetary light from a much brighter host star.

terms.name: Stability limit
terms.description: Residual light caused by changes in telescope optics.

abstractSummary.zh: 直接拍摄系外行星时，恒星眩光远强于行星信号，而望远镜的细微不稳定会让常规的参考星扣除留下残差。本文不再依赖参考图像，而是为 JWST 建立物理模型来重建并扣除星光。用这种方法重新处理存档数据后，探测灵敏度提高到原来的 2–15 倍，此前未检出的 51 Eridani b 也在数据中显现出来。
abstractSummary.en: Starlight overwhelms the faint signal from an exoplanet, and telescope instability limits conventional reference-image subtraction. The authors build a physical model of JWST to reconstruct and remove starlight. Reprocessing archival observations improves sensitivity by a reported factor of 2–15 and reveals the previously undetected planet 51 Eridani b.

en.headline: An AI-native laboratory plans and performs biomolecular experiments
en.summary: AutoDNA is an experimental laboratory designed around AI. It plans and schedules multi-objective biomolecular experiments across instruments and supports multiple users. The work describes how AI orchestration and automated hardware can be developed together rather than adding an agent to an otherwise unchanged laboratory.
en.question: How can AI coordinate biomolecular experiments across instruments and users?
en.approach: Co-develop AI orchestration and automated laboratory hardware for multi-objective experiments.

metadata.title: Advancing subseasonal forecasting with machine learning

zh.headline: 2–6 周的天气预报，机器学习把技巧翻了一倍
zh.summary: 次季节（2–6 周）预报长期被称为“可预报性沙漠”；作者提出概率偏差校正（PBC），学习并修正现有预报模型的系统性误差。
zh.question: 现有模型在 2–6 周上几乎不比气候平均好，能否改进？
zh.approach: 不重造模型，而是学习历史概率预报的系统误差，用两个轻量模型并行给出互补校正。
zh.finding: 让 ECMWF AI 预报系统的次季节技巧翻倍，并在 ECMWF 2025 实时预报竞赛中各变量、各时效均列第一。

terms.name: 次季节预报
terms.description: 提前 2–6 周的预报，介于天气预报与季节预测之间。

terms.name: 偏差校正
terms.description: 用统计或机器学习方法修正模型的系统性误差。

en.headline: Machine learning improves forecasts two to six weeks ahead
en.summary: Probabilistic bias correction learns forecast-distribution errors from historical predictions and observations. Evaluations cover ECMWF dynamical and AI forecasts, including real-time competition. Gains concern subseasonal skill, not elimination of weather uncertainty.
en.question: Can learned corrections improve forecasts in the difficult subseasonal range?
en.approach: Use complementary lightweight models to learn systematic forecast errors from historical predictions and observations.
steps: Produce corrected subseasonal forecasts, including extremes

flow.title: Predict
flow.description: Produce corrected subseasonal forecasts, including extremes

en.finding: The paper reports doubled ECMWF AI subseasonal skill and strong real-time competition results.
en.caution: Improved forecast skill does not eliminate weather uncertainty.
limitations: Improved forecast skill does not eliminate weather uncertainty.

terms.name: Subseasonal forecasting
terms.description: Forecasting conditions roughly two to six weeks ahead.

terms.name: Bias correction
terms.description: Adjusting systematic errors in a forecast distribution.

abstractSummary.zh: 2–6 周的次季节预报长期难以超越气候平均。作者提出的概率偏差校正不替换原有模型，而是学习并修正它们的系统性偏差，可以叠加在动力模型或 AI 模型之上；在 ECMWF 的模型和实时预报竞赛中都取得了明显提升。
abstractSummary.en: Probabilistic bias correction learns forecast-distribution errors from historical predictions and observations. Evaluations cover ECMWF dynamical and AI forecasts, including real-time competition. Gains concern subseasonal skill, not elimination of weather uncertainty.

titles.zh: 推理能否提升大语言模型的心理深度？
titles.en: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models?

label: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models?

metadata.title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models?

zh.headline: 推理模型写故事，未必更有“心理深度”
zh.summary: 作者让推理增强模型和对应的非推理模型写创意故事，再请人类读者评判“心理深度”，发现推理能力并不会普遍带来更好的创作。
zh.question: 推理基准上的优势能否迁移到创意写作？本文关注读者感受到的人物内心与情感，而不是故事是否答对问题；同时检验模型裁判能否代表人的偏好。
zh.approach: 7 位读者对 60 组匿名故事配对进行评价。对照包括 DeepSeek-R1 与 V3，以及两档推理强度的 GPT-5 与 GPT-4o；另用模型裁判比较同一批故事。模型对比并非只改变推理能力的严格消融。
zh.finding: 人类偏好因模型而异，差异未达到统计显著：GPT-5 获得 60.0–62.9% 的偏好，R1 为 42.9%。模型裁判却在 98.3% 的配对中偏向推理模型。不能把模型评分直接当作读者体验，也不能据此断言推理普遍有益或有害。
zh.caution: 只比较了两组模型对，结论的适用范围有限。
limitations: 只比较了两组模型对，结论的适用范围有限。

terms.name: 心理深度
terms.description: 读者感受到的人物内心、情感与动机的丰富程度。

en.headline: Stronger reasoning does not necessarily make stories psychologically deeper
en.summary: Seven annotators judged 60 blinded story pairs. GPT-5 was modestly preferred over GPT-4o, while R1 trailed V3. Model judges favored reasoning much more strongly, highlighting subjective reading experience.
en.question: Do reasoning gains transfer to creative writing, and can model judges represent readers' preferences about characters' inner lives?
en.approach: Seven readers evaluated 60 blinded story pairs: R1 versus V3 and GPT-5 versus GPT-4o at two reasoning settings. Model judges evaluated the same stories. These comparisons are not clean reasoning-only ablations.
steps: Select matched reasoning and non-reasoning models
Ask human readers to judge psychological depth

flow.title: Compare
flow.description: Select matched reasoning and non-reasoning models

flow.title: Evaluate
flow.description: Ask human readers to judge psychological depth

en.finding: Human preferences were 60.0–62.9% for GPT-5 and 42.9% for R1; neither difference was statistically significant. Model judges preferred reasoning in 98.3% of pairs. Their ratings should not be equated with readers' experience or a universal reasoning advantage.
en.caution: Only two model pairs are compared, limiting generalization.
limitations: Only two model pairs are compared, limiting generalization.

terms.name: Psychological depth
terms.description: The richness of characters' inner lives, emotions and motivations perceived by readers.

abstractSummary.zh: 研究背景是“推理更强，写作也会更好”的普遍假设。作者选取两组最接近的推理与非推理模型，请人类读者比较它们所写故事的心理深度。结果因模型而异：GPT-5 小幅胜过 GPT-4o，DeepSeek-R1 反而不及 V3，说明推理后训练并不会自动带来创作上的提升。
abstractSummary.en: Seven annotators judged 60 blinded story pairs. GPT-5 was modestly preferred over GPT-4o, while R1 trailed V3. Model judges favored reasoning much more strongly, highlighting subjective reading experience.

zh.headline: 把对话当成“调用工具”，智能体更会达成社交目标
zh.summary: 作者提出无需训练的 TMI 协议：把每句话当作工具调用、把对方回复当作工具结果，让模型沿用多步工具使用中练出的智能体能力去追求对话目标。
zh.question: 大模型在工具使用中练出的智能体能力，能否迁移到开放式多轮对话的目标追求？
zh.approach: 用“工具调用—工具结果”组织对话，保持推理—行动—观察循环，并保留推理与交互历史。
zh.finding: 在社交、情感支持、劝说、议价四类任务上优于普通对话基线，同时大幅减少推理 token。

en.headline: Treating conversation as tool use helps agents pursue social goals
en.summary: This study asks whether language models can transfer tool-use capabilities to open-ended conversations. Tool-Mediated Interaction represents dialogue as tool calls and returned results without additional training. Across social interaction, emotional support, persuasion and bargaining, the authors report improved goal attainment with lower reasoning overhead.
en.question: Can tool-use capabilities transfer to open-ended, multi-turn dialogue?
en.approach: Represent utterances as tool calls and replies as tool results without further training.

Measure goal attainment and reasoning overhead

abstractSummary.zh: 论文探讨大模型在工具调用任务中习得的能力，能否用于开放式多轮对话。作者把对话改写成“调用工具、获得结果”的形式（TMI），不需要额外训练。在社交、情感支持、劝说和议价等场景的大规模实验中，这种组织方式让模型更容易达成目标，同时大幅降低推理开销。

zh.headline: 像蛇一样爬行的软体机器人，深入小肠做检查和活检
zh.summary: BIOSENTER 是一种仿蛇的软体内镜机器人，靠充气腔体伸缩转向、借剪纸结构增加抓附，在临床前实验中完成了小肠内成像、活检和局部给药。
zh.question: 小肠又长又弯，现有小肠镜操作难、容易过度撑开组织，有没有更好的办法？
zh.approach: 模仿蛇的运动与鳞片：纤维增强的充气腔体负责伸缩与弯曲，头尾的剪纸结构套管交替锚定。
zh.finding: 在临床前研究中顺利通过小肠，实现了实时成像、组织活检和局部给药。
zh.caution: 仍处临床前阶段，需要在更贴近临床的模型中与现有小肠镜比较。
limitations: 仍处临床前阶段，需要在更贴近临床的模型中与现有小肠镜比较。

en.headline: A soft snake-inspired robot navigates the intestine
en.summary: The deep, winding small intestine is difficult to examine with conventional endoscopes. Inspired by snake locomotion, the researchers develop a soft enteroscopic robot that uses pneumatic extension and steering together with kirigami structures for traction. Preclinical experiments demonstrate imaging, biopsy and drug delivery; they do not establish clinical effectiveness in patients.
en.question: How can a soft robot navigate the winding small intestine and perform interventions?
en.approach: Combine pneumatic extension and steering with kirigami traction structures.
steps: Use front and rear traction structures
Control chambers to follow intestinal bends
Pass instruments through the central channel

zh.headline: 一个医疗基础模型，给出上千种临床结局的预测
zh.summary: PhenOM 在超过 4 亿份去标识化纵向病历上训练，用一个预训练模型为任意定义的结局、人群和时间窗生成风险评分，而不是每个结局单独建模。
zh.question: 临床预测模型通常“一种疾病、一个结局、一个模型”，能否用一个模型覆盖成千上万种结局？
zh.approach: 在纵向病历上预训练生成式基础模型，按需定义结局、人群与时间窗，输出可能性评分，并在独立保留集上验证。

en.headline: One medical foundation model predicts thousands of outcomes
en.summary: This medical preprint evaluates a general predictive model trained on large-scale de-identified health records. Rather than building one model per outcome, users define outcomes, populations and prediction windows to obtain risk scores. The authors report validation of thousands of prediction tasks on a large held-out dataset. This is not evidence of clinical benefit from deployment.
en.question: Can one general model support many clinical prediction tasks?
en.approach: Train on de-identified longitudinal records and evaluate user-defined outcomes, populations and time windows.
steps: Specify an outcome, population and prediction window
Evaluate risk predictions on held-out data

flow.description: Evaluate risk predictions on held-out data

en.finding: The authors report validation of 1,770 prediction tasks using a large held-out population.
en.caution: This preprint reports developer-led evaluation; independent validation and clinical benefit remain unestablished.
limitations: This preprint reports developer-led evaluation; independent validation and clinical benefit remain unestablished.

abstractSummary.zh: 这份医学预印本评估了一个基于海量去标识化病历训练的通用预测模型。与“一个结局一个模型”的传统做法不同，它可以按需定义结局、人群和时间窗来输出风险评分；作者报告了上千个预测任务在大规模独立保留集上的验证结果。
abstractSummary.en: This medical preprint evaluates a general predictive model trained on large-scale de-identified health records. Rather than building one model per outcome, users define outcomes, populations and prediction windows to obtain risk scores. The authors report validation of thousands of prediction tasks on a large held-out dataset. This is not evidence of clinical benefit from deployment.

metadata.title: Simultaneous high-fidelity single-qubit gates in a spin qubit array

zh.headline: 五个硅量子比特共用一根控制线，仍能同时高精度操控
zh.summary: 作者用一根共享微波线控制五个硅自旋量子比特，找出了微波信号改变能级所带来的相位误差，并给出逐对校准方案。
zh.question: 扩展硅量子芯片时，共享控制线会带来什么误差？能否同时高精度操控多个比特？
zh.approach: 分析微波控制信号引起的能级偏移与相位变化，设计逐对校准协议加以补偿。
zh.finding: 单个比特操作保真度超过 99.99%，五个比特同时操控时仍约 99.9%。

terms.name: 自旋量子比特
terms.description: 用电子或原子核的自旋方向编码量子信息，可在硅芯片上制备。

en.headline: Shared control enables simultaneous high-fidelity spin-qubit gates
en.summary: Scaling silicon spin-qubit arrays requires shared control lines. In a five-qubit array, the researchers identify phase errors associated with a shared microwave line and compensate for them through pairwise calibration. The approach enables simultaneous high-fidelity single-qubit control, while larger arrays remain to be evaluated.
en.question: How can spin qubits share control hardware without losing gate fidelity?
en.approach: Identify shared-line phase errors and compensate for them through pairwise calibration.
steps: Use a five-qubit silicon array with a shared microwave line

flow.title: Build
flow.description: Use a five-qubit silicon array with a shared microwave line

en.finding: Five qubits can be controlled simultaneously with reported fidelity of about 99.9%.
en.caution: Results from a five-qubit array do not establish performance at larger scales.
limitations: Results from a five-qubit array do not establish performance at larger scales.

terms.name: Spin qubit
terms.description: A quantum bit encoded in a particle's spin.

abstractSummary.zh: 硅基量子芯片要扩大规模，就需要多个比特共享控制线。RIKEN 团队在五比特阵列上找出了共享微波线带来的相位误差来源，并通过逐对校准加以补偿，让多个比特能同时被高精度操控。
abstractSummary.en: Scaling silicon spin-qubit arrays requires shared control lines. In a five-qubit array, the researchers identify phase errors associated with a shared microwave line and compensate for them through pairwise calibration. The approach enables simultaneous high-fidelity single-qubit control, while larger arrays remain to be evaluated.

titles.zh: 迈向具有生态学意义的基础模型

zh.headline: 生态学需要自己的“基础模型”吗？一份路线图
zh.summary: 作者主张构建生态基础模型（ecoFM）：在大规模多模态生态数据上训练并融入生态学理论，用来理解物种互作、预测生态系统对环境变化的响应。
zh.question: 生态数据与理论都很零散，模型难以跨系统、跨尺度泛化，怎么办？
zh.approach: 提出 ecoFM 路线图：整合多模态数据、引入生态理论、发展新架构、评估预测可靠性，并讨论治理。
zh.finding: ecoFM 既服务生态学，也是机器学习的高难度试验场，推动多模态表示、理论引导建模与不确定性推断。
zh.caution: 生态数据常不完整，且偏向研究充分的物种与地区。
limitations: 生态数据常不完整，且偏向研究充分的物种与地区。

terms.name: 基础模型
terms.description: 在海量数据上预训练、可迁移到多种下游任务的大模型。

en.headline: Building foundation models around ecological meaning
en.summary: This perspective proposes ecologically meaningful foundation models guided by ecological theory and trained on multimodal observations. It outlines priorities for data, architectures, evaluation and governance. The authors emphasize gaps and biases in ecological observations; the article offers a research roadmap rather than a demonstrated universal model.
en.question: What would make foundation models useful and reliable for ecology?
en.approach: Combine multimodal ecological observations with ecological theory and appropriate evaluation.
steps: Combine images, audio and ecological surveys

flow.title: Observe
flow.description: Combine images, audio and ecological surveys

en.finding: The perspective outlines priorities for data, architectures, uncertainty and governance.
en.caution: Ecological observations remain incomplete and biased across species and regions; this is a roadmap, not a universal model.
limitations: Ecological observations remain incomplete and biased across species and regions; this is a roadmap, not a universal model.

terms.name: Foundation model
terms.description: A broadly trained model adaptable to multiple downstream tasks.

abstractSummary.zh: 这是一篇观点文章。作者认为生态学的数据类型繁杂、理论分散，现有模型往往只适用于特定系统；他们提出以生态理论为指导、在多模态生态数据上训练“生态基础模型”，并就数据、架构、评估和治理给出路线图，同时提醒生态数据存在的缺口与偏差。
abstractSummary.en: This perspective proposes ecologically meaningful foundation models guided by ecological theory and trained on multimodal observations. It outlines priorities for data, architectures, evaluation and governance. The authors emphasize gaps and biases in ecological observations; the article offers a research roadmap rather than a demonstrated universal model.

zh.headline: 一个库打通 Lean 证明的数据、训练和证明搜索
zh.summary: LeanDojo-v2 把代码库数据抽取、模型微调、证明搜索和 AI 补全整合进一个软件库，降低数学家用 AI 辅助 Lean 证明的门槛。
zh.question: 怎样让研究者不用复杂搭建，就能在自己的 Lean 项目上试用 AI 辅助证明？
zh.approach: 提供端到端框架：抽取仓库数据 → 微调语言模型 → 证明搜索 → 编辑器内的 AI 补全与辅助证明。
zh.finding: 研究者可以在特定领域的 Lean 代码库上微调模型，并直接实验 AI 辅助定理证明。

terms.name: Lean
terms.description: 一种交互式定理证明器：证明写成代码，由机器逐步检查。

en.headline: A unified workflow for AI-assisted Lean proofs
en.summary: LeanDojo-v2 connects data extraction from Lean projects, model fine-tuning, proof search and editor-based AI suggestions. The library provides a reusable workflow for studying AI-assisted theorem proving on users' own repositories, reducing the need to assemble separate tools. Formal proof checking remains distinct from generating a plausible proof suggestion.
en.question: How can researchers use AI theorem proving on their own Lean repositories?
en.approach: Integrate repository data extraction, fine-tuning, proof search and editor-based suggestions.

Adapt a language model to repository data
Provide AI suggestions in the editor

titles.zh: RPEG：可扩展且经济高效的推理语言模型训练
titles.en: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively

label: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively

metadata.title: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively

zh.headline: 把推理模型的强化学习训练，画成一张可优化的“图”
zh.summary: 推理模型的强化学习训练要同时调度多个大模型和多个异步阶段，成本高、难扩展；RPEG 用图来描述整条训练流水线，并配一个性能模型来系统地优化它。
zh.question: 推理模型的强化学习训练为什么难扩展、成本高？能否系统地优化？
zh.approach: 把训练流程表示成图，暴露“有界异步”“演员—评论家共享”等结构选择，再叠加阶段融合、细粒度调度、多维并行等执行优化。
zh.finding: 配套的分析性能模型同时刻画计算、通信、内存以及机架、节点、GPU 多层级效应，用来指导配置选择。

terms.name: 强化学习后训练
terms.description: 预训练之后，用奖励信号继续训练模型，以提升推理等能力。

terms.name: 有界异步
terms.description: 允许不同阶段之间有限度地不同步，以换取更高吞吐。

en.headline: A graph view of scalable reasoning-model training
en.summary: Reinforcement learning for reasoning models involves multiple models and asynchronous execution stages. RPEG represents the training pipeline as a graph and combines structural and execution optimizations. A performance model accounts for computation, communication, memory and heterogeneous hardware to compare configurations for more scalable, cost-effective training.
en.question: How can reinforcement-learning pipelines for reasoning models become more efficient?
en.approach: Represent the pipeline as a graph and combine structural choices with execution optimizations.
steps: Build a graph of the training pipeline
Explore structural options and bounded asynchrony
Fuse stages and schedule parallel execution
Estimate compute, communication and memory costs

flow.title: Represent
flow.description: Build a graph of the training pipeline

flow.title: Choose
flow.description: Explore structural options and bounded asynchrony

flow.title: Optimize
flow.description: Fuse stages and schedule parallel execution

flow.title: Analyze
flow.description: Estimate compute, communication and memory costs

en.finding: An analytical model accounts for computation, communication, memory and hardware when comparing configurations.
en.caution: Efficiency gains depend on pipeline and hardware configuration.
limitations: Efficiency gains depend on pipeline and hardware configuration.

terms.name: Reinforcement-learning post-training
terms.description: Training a model using reward signals after pretraining.

terms.name: Bounded asynchrony
terms.description: Allowing execution stages to overlap within controlled limits.

abstractSummary.zh: 推理模型的强化学习训练涉及多个模型和异步阶段的协同，扩展难、成本高。RPEG 把整条流水线抽象成图，在图上组合结构选择与执行层优化，并用一个覆盖计算、通信、内存和多级硬件的性能模型来评估不同配置，目标是让这类训练更可扩展、更省钱。
abstractSummary.en: Reinforcement learning for reasoning models involves multiple models and asynchronous execution stages. RPEG represents the training pipeline as a graph and combines structural and execution optimizations. A performance model accounts for computation, communication, memory and heterogeneous hardware to compare configurations for more scalable, cost-effective training.

titles.zh: 通过特征级感知与提示驱动物体检测实现人形机器人高效示范学习
titles.en: Data-Efficient Learning from Demonstration for Humanoid Robots via Feature-Level Perception and Prompt-Based Object Detection

label: Data-Efficient Learning from Demonstration for Humanoid Robots via Feature-Level Perception and Prompt-Based Object Detection

metadata.title: Data-Efficient Learning from Demonstration for Humanoid Robots via Feature-Level Perception and Prompt-Based Object Detection

zh.headline: 16 次示范，就让人形机器人学会抓取放置
zh.summary: 作者让人形机器人从紧凑的任务特征而不是原始图像中学习示范，用时序模型预测关节轨迹，用很少的示范就掌握操作技能。
zh.question: 人形机器人从示范中学习通常需要大量数据，能否省很多？
zh.approach: 用提示式目标检测提取任务相关的紧凑特征，再训练时序深度模型预测关节角轨迹。
zh.finding: 仿真中抓取放置 16 次示范达到 78% 成功率，100 次升至 86%；推动任务 8 次示范达 71%。
zh.caution: 定量结果主要来自仿真，实机部分为演示。
limitations: 定量结果主要来自仿真，实机部分为演示。

terms.name: 示范学习
terms.description: 机器人通过观察人类示范来学习技能（LfD）。

en.headline: Learning humanoid manipulation from a few demonstrations
en.summary: The authors investigate learning humanoid manipulation from few demonstrations. Prompt-based object detection reduces visual scenes to task-relevant features, and a temporal model predicts joint trajectories. Experiments with a simulated NAO robot cover pick-and-place and pushing. The reported success rates do not by themselves demonstrate robustness on physical robots.
en.question: Can compact perceptual features reduce the demonstrations needed for robot learning?
en.approach: Use prompt-based object detection and a temporal model to predict joint trajectories.
steps: Detect task-relevant objects and compact features

flow.title: Perceive
flow.description: Detect task-relevant objects and compact features

en.finding: The study reports pick-and-place and pushing results using small demonstration sets.
en.caution: Reported quantitative success rates are primarily from simulation; physical demonstrations do not establish broad real-world robustness.
limitations: Reported quantitative success rates are primarily from simulation; physical demonstrations do not establish broad real-world robustness.

terms.name: Learning from demonstration
terms.description: Learning a task from examples of its execution.

abstractSummary.zh: 论文关注人形机器人如何用尽量少的示范学会操作技能。作者先用提示式目标检测把场景压缩成少量任务特征，再用时序模型预测关节轨迹；在 NAO 机器人上验证，少量示范就能在仿真的抓取放置与推动任务中取得较高成功率。
abstractSummary.en: The authors investigate learning humanoid manipulation from few demonstrations. Prompt-based object detection reduces visual scenes to task-relevant features, and a temporal model predicts joint trajectories. Experiments with a simulated NAO robot cover pick-and-place and pushing. The reported success rates do not by themselves demonstrate robustness on physical robots.

zh.headline: 换一种电解液分解方式，让无负极钠电池更耐用
zh.summary: 无负极钠电池能量密度高，但循环中会不可逆地损失钠；作者引入一种中等环张力的环醚，让电解液按可控方式分解，形成又薄又稳的界面层。
zh.question: 无负极钠电池为什么寿命短？能否减少循环中的钠损失？
zh.approach: 加入中等环张力的环状醚，引导电解液的分解路径（可控低聚），形成薄而坚固的界面层。
zh.finding: 界面层减少了钠的消耗，延长了电池的循环稳定性。

terms.name: 无负极电池
terms.description: 组装时不放负极金属，充电时金属直接沉积在集流体上，能量密度更高。

terms.name: 界面层
terms.description: 电极表面由电解液分解形成的薄层，很大程度决定电池寿命。

en.headline: Controlled oligomerization stabilizes anode-free sodium batteries
en.summary: Anode-free sodium batteries offer high theoretical energy density but lose active sodium during cycling. The authors use a cyclic ether with moderate ring strain to change electrolyte decomposition and form a thin, dense interphase. Controlled oligomerization reduces sodium loss and improves cycling under the reported experimental conditions.
en.question: How can anode-free sodium batteries reduce the loss of active sodium?
en.approach: Use a cyclic ether with moderate ring strain to guide electrolyte decomposition.
steps: Select a moderately strained cyclic ether
Build a protective interphase through controlled oligomerization
Evaluate sodium retention and cycling stability

zh.headline: 用溶液法做出 18.53% 效率的铜铟镓硒太阳能电池
zh.summary: 溶液法制备黄铜矿电池难以控制物相演变和成分均匀性；作者用醋酸根在前驱体溶液中构建络合网络，实现单相结晶与均匀的镓合金化。
zh.question: 溶液法制备 CIGS 薄膜时，如何控制物相演变和成分均匀性？

zh.finding: 实现单相结晶与均匀的镓合金化，电池效率达到 18.53%。

en.headline: Chemical linkages guide efficient solution-processed solar cells
en.summary: Solution processing could reduce the cost of copper indium gallium selenide solar cells, but controlling phase formation and composition is difficult. An acetate-mediated chemical linkage network guides single-phase crystallization and uniform gallium alloying. The resulting devices achieve a reported efficiency of 18.53%.
en.question: How can solution processing achieve uniform composition and single-phase CIGS films?
en.approach: Use an acetate-mediated chemical linkage network in the precursor.

abstractSummary.zh: 溶液法有望降低铜铟镓硒薄膜电池的成本，但物相与成分难以控制。作者借助醋酸根在前驱体中形成的化学连接网络，引导薄膜单相结晶并让镓分布均匀，最终获得 18.53% 的电池效率。
abstractSummary.en: Solution processing could reduce the cost of copper indium gallium selenide solar cells, but controlling phase formation and composition is difficult. An acetate-mediated chemical linkage network guides single-phase crystallization and uniform gallium alloying. The resulting devices achieve a reported efficiency of 18.53%.

zh.headline: 自主实验找催化剂，还能讲清楚“为什么”
zh.summary: 自主催化剂发现常依赖黑箱模型；作者把化学知识融入多臂老虎机决策框架，自主找到高性能析氢催化剂，并揭示合成条件如何影响活性。
zh.question: 自主实验平台常用黑箱模型、化学洞见有限，能否既高效又可解释？
zh.approach: 把化学先验融入多臂老虎机框架，指导自主实验逐轮选择合成条件。
zh.finding: 找到了高性能的析氢反应催化剂，并解释了合成条件对催化活性的作用。

terms.name: 多臂老虎机

en.headline: Chemical knowledge makes autonomous catalyst search interpretable
en.summary: Autonomous catalyst optimization often relies on algorithms whose decisions are difficult to interpret. This work embeds chemical knowledge in a multi-armed bandit framework to select experiments efficiently while retaining interpretability. The campaign identifies active hydrogen-evolution catalysts and examines relationships between synthesis conditions and catalytic activity.
en.question: Can autonomous catalyst optimization remain interpretable while selecting useful experiments?
en.approach: Embed chemical knowledge in a multi-armed bandit framework.
steps: Relate synthesis conditions to measured activity

flow.title: Explain
flow.description: Relate synthesis conditions to measured activity

en.finding: The campaign identifies active hydrogen-evolution catalysts and relationships between synthesis and activity.
en.caution: Findings are tied to the evaluated catalyst campaign.
limitations: Findings are tied to the evaluated catalyst campaign.

terms.name: Multi-armed bandit
terms.description: A decision framework balancing exploration with exploitation.

terms.name: Hydrogen evolution
terms.description: An electrochemical reaction producing hydrogen.

abstractSummary.zh: 用自主实验平台寻找催化剂时，常见的黑箱优化难以解释结果。作者把化学先验嵌入多臂老虎机决策过程，让平台选择实验条件时既高效又可解释，最终找到高活性的析氢催化剂，并厘清了合成条件与活性的关系。
abstractSummary.en: Autonomous catalyst optimization often relies on algorithms whose decisions are difficult to interpret. This work embeds chemical knowledge in a multi-armed bandit framework to select experiments efficiently while retaining interpretability. The campaign identifies active hydrogen-evolution catalysts and examines relationships between synthesis conditions and catalytic activity.

titles.zh: 人类顶叶数字编码中的分布式范围适应
titles.en: Distributed range adaptation in human parietal encoding of numbers

label: Distributed range adaptation in human parietal encoding of numbers

metadata.title: Distributed range adaptation in human parietal encoding of numbers

zh.headline: 大脑会按“最近见到的数字范围”重新调校
zh.summary: 功能磁共振研究显示，人类顶叶皮层中对数量敏感的神经群体，会根据遇到的数字范围平移并缩放自己的调谐。
zh.question: 大脑对数量的编码是固定的，还是会随环境中的数字范围而调整？
zh.approach: 用 fMRI 测量顶叶皮层中数量敏感神经群体在不同数字范围下的调谐变化。
zh.finding: 这些神经群体会平移并缩放调谐以匹配所遇到的范围，这种灵活性支撑了行为上的适应。

terms.name: 调谐
terms.description: 神经元或神经群体对不同刺激值的偏好曲线。

en.headline: The brain adapts its numerical code to recent experience
en.summary: Using functional MRI, the authors study how human parietal cortex represents different numerical ranges. Neural populations encoding quantity shift and rescale with recently experienced ranges rather than maintaining fixed responses. The findings connect adaptive population representations with flexible numerical judgments.
en.question: Does parietal number encoding adapt to recently experienced numerical ranges?
en.approach: Use functional MRI to measure population responses across numerical ranges.
steps: Expose participants to different number ranges
Record parietal activity with functional MRI
Relate adaptive coding to numerical judgments

flow.title: Present
flow.description: Expose participants to different number ranges

flow.title: Measure
flow.description: Record parietal activity with functional MRI

flow.title: Interpret
flow.description: Relate adaptive coding to numerical judgments

en.finding: Number-selective populations shift and rescale their responses with recent ranges.
en.caution: The findings concern the measured task and population responses.
limitations: The findings concern the measured task and population responses.

terms.name: Tuning
terms.description: A response preference for particular stimuli or quantities.

abstractSummary.zh: 研究者用功能磁共振观察人在面对不同数字区间时顶叶皮层的反应，发现表征数量的神经群体并非一成不变，而会随近期遇到的数字范围移动和伸缩，这可能是人们灵活适应不同数量情境的神经基础。
abstractSummary.en: Using functional MRI, the authors study how human parietal cortex represents different numerical ranges. Neural populations encoding quantity shift and rescale with recently experienced ranges rather than maintaining fixed responses. The findings connect adaptive population representations with flexible numerical judgments.

titles.zh: 通过模型到策略表述统一具身基础模型
titles.en: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation

label: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation

metadata.title: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation

zh.headline: 用一套概率框架，统一各种机器人基础模型
zh.summary: 视觉—语言—动作模型和世界—动作模型在架构、输出和训练目标上各不相同；作者提出与架构无关的概率框架，把它们统一描述为“从模型到机器人策略”。
zh.question: 各类具身基础模型差异很大，能否用统一的方式理解它们如何变成机器人策略？
zh.approach: 基于随机核，用条件输出分布和“动作实现核”刻画模型，并把预训练、后训练与部署联系起来。
zh.finding: 把框架实例化到 OpenVLA（自回归预测动作 token）和 DreamZero（视频与动作联合生成）。

terms.name: VLA 模型
terms.description: 同时理解视觉与语言、直接输出机器人动作的模型。

en.headline: A common model-to-policy language for embodied AI
en.summary: This theoretical work offers an architecture-independent probabilistic description of embodied foundation models. A model-to-policy formulation explains how models become executable robot policies through action realization, and places pretraining, post-training and deployment in one framework. OpenVLA and DreamZero illustrate the formulation; the framework is not itself a new robot benchmark result.
en.question: How can different embodied foundation models be described in one framework?
en.approach: Use stochastic kernels to connect conditional model outputs with action realization.
steps: Relate training stages to policy deployment

flow.title: Connect
flow.description: Relate training stages to policy deployment

en.finding: The formulation relates pretraining, post-training and deployment across architectures.
en.caution: This theoretical framework is not itself a new robot benchmark result.
limitations: This theoretical framework is not itself a new robot benchmark result.

terms.name: Vision-language-action model
terms.description: A model connecting visual and language inputs with actions.

abstractSummary.zh: 机器人领域出现了多种基础模型，结构和训练方式差别很大。这篇理论文章给出一个不依赖具体架构的概率描述，说明各类模型如何经由“动作实现”变成可执行的机器人策略，并把预训练、后训练和部署放进同一框架讨论，以 OpenVLA 和 DreamZero 为例。
abstractSummary.en: This theoretical work offers an architecture-independent probabilistic description of embodied foundation models. A model-to-policy formulation explains how models become executable robot policies through action realization, and places pretraining, post-training and deployment in one framework. OpenVLA and DreamZero illustrate the formulation; the framework is not itself a new robot benchmark result.
